name: QEMU vfio-user PCI endpoint device for virtualized computational storage

mentions.name: QEMU vfio-user PCI endpoint device for virtualized computational storage
mentions.description: A QEMU device that exposes a vfio-user socket for a PCI endpoint controller, accompanied by a Linux PCI endpoint controller driver and a userspace endpoint function. Together these components are used to build a virtualized computational storage device for research. It is currently unstable, with plans for a fully working implementation by the end of the next month.
mentions.source_excerpt:
QEMU device that exposes a vfio-user socket for a PCI endpoint controller, Linux PCI endpoint controller driver and a userspace endpoint function.

It's very unstable at the moment but plan to have it fully implemented and working by the end of next month.

Using it to build a virtualized computational storage device for research.
